'''Mangrill''' was a member of the [[Space Rescue Corps/Legends|Space Rescue Corps]] who worked alongside [[Jandrell]]. They worked together to rescue a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who had flown through a grade five [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] and disabled his ship.
